title: Family
description: Link parents and children. Family members can see each other's private details.
sent: Request sent. It will be linked once they confirm.
sentAdmin: Added. An administrator will confirm this link.

steps.one: Search for your family member by name below.
steps.two: Choose “This is my child” (or parent) to send a request.
steps.three: Once they accept, you are linked and can see each other’s contact details.

claimChild.title: Add my child
claimChild.description: Search for your child's account. They will be asked to confirm.
claimChild.minorHint: Current students only appear when you enter their full registered name.
claimChild.manualTitle: My child doesn't have an account
claimChild.manualHint: An administrator will check and confirm this.
claimChild.cohortHint: Numbered by the year they finish (finished) 6th grade.
claimChild.leftYearHint: Only if they left before graduating.

claimParent.title: Add my parent
claimParent.description: Search for your parent's account. They will be asked to confirm.

errors.notAllowed: Your account type can't add this kind of family link.
errors.wrongRole: That member isn't registered as a parent or student.
errors.already: This family link already exists or is waiting for confirmation.
errors.tooMany: You have too many unconfirmed requests. Please wait for them to be confirmed.

notify.asChildText: {name} says they are your parent on AIS Alumni. Please confirm or decline on the Family page.
notify.asParentText: {name} says you are their parent on AIS Alumni. Please confirm or decline on the Family page.

managed.title: Children you manage
managed.description: Accounts you registered for your children when you applied. Your children don't sign in; you manage them. The committee checks their AIS details and approves them.

handover.intro: Let your child sign in themselves. We'll email a handover link to your child (valid for 7 days). Once they accept, the account is theirs and no longer managed by you. Your family link stays.
handover.emailHint: Use an address your child can read.
handover.sent: Handover link sent. Ask your child to check their email.

errors.notFound: We couldn't find this child's account.
errors.notActive: You can hand it over once the committee has approved it.

claim.title: Take over your account
claim.body: {parent} is handing {child}'s account over to you. Once you confirm, you'll sign in with {email}.
claim.point1: Your class, AIS record and family links come with it.
claim.point2: If you've already registered with this email, the two accounts are combined into one.
claim.point3: Afterwards you can set your photo, LINE and more yourself.
claim.signedIn: You're signed in to another account. After confirming, sign out and sign in with the handed-over email.
claim.invalid: This link is invalid or has expired. Ask your parent to send it again.
claim.signInWith: Sign in with the code we'll email to {email}.
claim.signOutAndIn: Sign out and sign in again

done.subject: Your child's account has been handed over
done.text: {child} has taken over their account and can now sign in themselves. Your family link stays.

emailMessage.subject: AIS Alumni: take over your account
emailMessage.text:
{parent} is handing over the AIS Alumni account they registered for {child} to you.
Open the link below and press “Take over my account” to sign in with this email (valid for 7 days).
If this wasn't expected, ignore this email.
